questions: (1) a LOCAL, unitary, charge-conserving term that gives mass to the 4 pi-valleys of one copy while the low-energy electron (E(0), kinetic mass, dispersion) is untouched up to O(k^4); including VUOTO_POLARIZZA's breathing coin theta -/+ mu (read only, lab/vuoto_f2_breath.py, docs/VUOTO_POLARIZZA.md par. 7.1 and 13).
(2) how the historical Schwinger studies counted pairs (IDEE_RIPRESE R1, COPPIE_IN_SCATOLA): bookkeeping from the code (lab/redo_r1.py, lab/box_core.py), no new run needed.
(3) the pair of levels 0.8811 / 0.8822 (twisted Wilson h = 0.1, nucleus on the corner, phase 3).
engine: lab/locale_f4_core.py: walk(theta, mu_x, mu_y, hu, hs): coin of tick t = exp(-i[(theta + s_t mu_x) X + s_t mu_y Y]), s = (-1, +1) (breathing; mu_y = 'twisted' breathing); twisted link Wilson (axis Y, links 2e_j) of strength hu + s'_t hs, s' = (+1, -1) (uniform + alternating in time). hu = 0.1, hs = 0 is F2 of phase 1.

candidates.C5 k^2-cancelled: mu_x in {0.1, 0.3}, hu in {0, 0.1}; hs found by root finding so that the kinetic mass along x equals the frozen one (ONE condition = a principle that fixes hs, counted as a tuned ratio, not a free knob); sign of hs searched in [-0.5, 0.5].

exams.Q1_gap: smallest half-gap over the 7 doubler valleys and over a 24^3 zone grid outside |k| < 0.4 (from 0 and from pi) >= 0.3 / a (as D5 of phase 1), at theta = 0.1.
exams.Q3_mkin: |m_kin / m_kin(frozen) - 1| <= 1e-4 along 4 directions (axis, face, body, (1,2,3)), theta = 0.1.
exams.Q4_k4: deviation from the frozen dispersion dE(p), p in [0.1, 2] m (12 points, worst of 4 directions): power-law slope >= 3.5 AND |dE|/m <= 1e-4 at p = m.
exams.verdict: a candidate is FOUND if Q1-Q4 all pass. Also run at theta = 0.02 for the found ones (information).
exams.H2_history: state explicitly whether the historical counts were projected on the k = 0 hole; if yes, the quoted 0.3 % (Schwinger) stands.
exams.X1_pair: hypothesis: 0.8811 / 0.8822 is the 1s spin doublet split because, in its copy (lattice 2Z^3), the corner nucleus sits OFF-centre (at (1/4,1/4,1/4) of the copy cell) and the axis order of the rule leaves little symmetry. Tests (reduced model of phase 3, F2 h = 0.1, corner): (a) initial spinor spin-down and spin-x: the same two energies (|dE| <= 1e-4) must appear with DIFFERENT weights, and the two levels must have spin expectations pointing in different directions (|<S>_1 - <S>_2| >= 0.5 in units of hbar); (b) nucleus on a site of the copy (centre case, phase 3: split 1e-5) -> doublet nearly degenerate (<= 1e-4): already seen in phase 3, restated. PASS if (a) holds.
